name: Organisation settings
summary: Company-level settings for enterprise admins: the organisation profile, organisation integrations, project creation and approval rules, and data export controls. Mostly PRD-only today; profile edits are support-only.

roles.note: The PRD wants organisation and regional admins to manage these settings and leaves per-section roles open. Today only the profile update exists, and only support users can call it.

actions.note: Current behaviour; PRD wants org admins to edit it (ENT-REQ-008)

actions.action: Set project creation and approval rules
Turn data export on or off and issue a Power BI key

nfr.statement: How quickly a changed export or project-creation setting takes effect across all of the company's projects.
nfr.open_question: Must a disabled export option stop downloads immediately, including for sessions already open?

requirements.title: Organisation admins manage the organisation profile
requirements.statement: Organisation admins see and edit the organisation profile (name, logo, website, phone, address, time zone). The contact email is shown but can't be edited.

dispute.summary: The PRD gives profile editing to organisation and regional admins. The code refuses company updates from anyone who is not a Track3D support user, and accepts any field in the body, including the contact email. Product to decide in DEC-071.

sources.title: Prior PRDs - Enterprise workspace (admin dashboard, org settings, activity log, enterprise account, gamification, multiple emails)
Direct code reads during USER migration (2026-10-29)

acceptance_criteria.given: An organisation admin on the Settings, Organisation section
acceptance_criteria.when: They try to change the contact email
acceptance_criteria.then: The field can't be edited and a message says why

acceptance_criteria.given: A company super-admin who is not a support user
acceptance_criteria.when: They save a new company phone number
acceptance_criteria.then: (Current behaviour) The update is refused with "Access denied"

requirements.title: Organisation integrations are managed in one place
requirements.statement: Organisation admins see every available integration, its status and the projects connected to it, and can disconnect a project from an integration.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. No organisation-level integration settings were found; integrations are managed per project today (INTG).

sources.title: Prior PRDs - Enterprise workspace (admin dashboard, org settings, activity log, enterprise account, gamification, multiple emails)

acceptance_criteria.given: An integration connected to three of the company's projects
acceptance_criteria.then: They see the integration's status and the three projects, each with a disconnect option

requirements.title: Organisations can restrict project creation and set approval criteria
requirements.statement: Organisation admins can limit project creation to organisation and regional admins, and set the approval criteria for new projects. Today's approval rules are in PROJ (PROJ-REQ-004) and USER-REQ-039.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. No settings screen or stored setting for this was found.

requirements.title: Organisations control data export
requirements.statement: Organisation admins can turn data export by download on or off, turn Power BI export on or off, and generate an API key for Power BI export.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. No organisation-level export switch or Power BI key was found on the branches read.
